payload.main_problem: Because I did not receive a raise, I feel like a terrible employee at work.
payload.core_demands: Not receiving a raise and feelings of inadequacy have affected my self-esteem and overall well-being, which prompted me to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: About six months ago, Zhou Cheng realized that he had not received a raise while his colleagues had, which made him begin to feel persistently incompetent and doubt his work performance; the problem persisted and affected his self-esteem and work motivation. He tried seeking feedback from his supervisor and working harder, but saw no improvement; whenever he sees colleagues receiving recognition or rewards, this sense of inadequacy is reactivated.

During a singer audition, excessive stress caused his voice to crack and him to forget the lyrics; after failing on the spot, he repeatedly recalled the embarrassing scene and developed the thought 'I cannot sing well', began to avoid singing and even practicing, believed that trying again was meaningless, which led to a decline in interest and confidence in an activity he originally loved.

special_situations.event: Sees colleagues receiving commendation or rewards/raises
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not receive the same raise or recognition as my colleagues, it means I am incompetent and an unqualified employee
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Works harder and proactively seeks feedback from his supervisor to prove himself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them; I must be a terrible employee.

special_situations.event: Discovered that he had not received a raise while colleagues had (about six months ago)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the company does not give me a raise, the reason must lie with me, which shows I performed poorly
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-reflects and doubles his efforts, trying to exchange improved performance for recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Not getting a raise means I am no good.

special_situations.event: After seeking feedback from his supervisor and working harder, still no obvious improvement
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I still see no change after trying hard, it proves I will never get better
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids seeking help from family, chooses to bear stress alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may never receive recognition / will never get a raise.

special_situations.event: Failed singer audition (voice cracking, forgetting lyrics)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail in public, it means I am completely no good in this area
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids singing and practicing to avoid failing and being embarrassed again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can never sing well again; trying again is meaningless.
